description: Read a receipt back as JSON by its id. Folded, it returns the twelve lines and a pay object naming where a human pays. With a bearer token that has credit it unseals: the evidence and the fix paragraph for every open line, and the SOTA Security Model read of the app. One fixed price per unsealed report. 401 for a token we did not issue, 402 when the balance will not cover it.

token.description: Optional API credit token. Without it the receipt comes back folded.

name: get_receipt
title: Read a receipt, and unseal it if there is credit
